# FontWeight

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Font weight values following the CSS/OpenType weight scale. Standard PDF fonts support Normal (400) and Bold (700). Custom TTF fonts may support additional weights.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Thin`
- `ExtraLight`
- `Light`
- `Normal`
- `Medium`
- `SemiBold`
- `Bold`
- `ExtraBold`
- `Black`
